entities.summary: Ernesto Julio Álvarez Miranda is a Peruvian jurist and academic who has served as the Prime Minister of Peru from October 2025 to February 2026, under the presidency of José Jerí. A ranking member of the Christian People's Party, he serves as chair of the party's advisory council since 2023. The Associated Press described him as having ultraconservative political views.
